translations.literal: within thirty days they will surely be defeated and broken.
translations.idiomatic: within thirty days they will surely be defeated and broken.

sentences.zh: 臣又聞吳起為將，暑不張蓋，寒不披裘；

translations.literal: Your servant also heard that when Wu Qi was general he did not raise an awning in summer or wear fur in winter;
translations.idiomatic: Your servant also heard that when Wu Qi was general he did not raise an awning in summer or wear fur in winter;

sentences.zh: 今賢野次垂幕，珍餚雜遝，兒子侍妾，事與古反。

translations.literal: now Xian in the field pitches curtains, rare delicacies are piled in confusion, sons and concubines attend him—conduct opposite to antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: now Ma Xian in the field pitches curtains, rare delicacies are piled in confusion, sons and concubines attend him—conduct opposite to antiquity.

sentences.zh: 臣懼賢等專守一城，言攻於西而羌出於東，且其將士將不堪命，必有高克潰叛之變也。

translations.literal: Your servant fears Xian and others will only hold one city, speaking of attack in the west while Qiang emerge in the east, and that his officers and soldiers will not bear their orders—there will surely be mutiny and collapse like at Gaokeng.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant fears Ma Xian and others will only hold one city, speaking of attack in the west while Qiang emerge in the east, and that his officers and soldiers will not bear their orders—there will surely be mutiny and collapse like at Gaokeng.

sentences.zh: 」安定人皇甫規亦見賢不恤軍事，審其必敗，上書言狀。

translations.literal: " Huangfu Gui of Anding also saw that Xian did not care for military affairs, was sure he would fail, and submitted a memorial stating the facts.
translations.idiomatic: " Huangfu Gui of Anding also saw that Ma Xian did not care for military affairs, was sure he would fail, and submitted a memorial stating the facts.

sentences.zh: 朝廷皆不從。

translations.literal: The court would not follow any of this.
translations.idiomatic: The court would not follow any of this.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，丙子，征西將軍馬賢與且凍羌戰於射姑山，賢軍敗；

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on bingzi, General Who Pacifies the West Ma Xian fought the Qiandong Qiang at Mount Shegu, and Xian's army was defeated;
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on bingzi day, General Who Pacifies the West Ma Xian fought the Qiandong Qiang at Mount Shegu, and Xian's army was defeated;

sentences.zh: 賢及二子皆沒，東、西羌遂大合。

translations.literal: Xian and his two sons all perished, and the Eastern and Western Qiang then joined in great union.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xian and his two sons all perished, and the Eastern and Western Qiang then joined in great union.

sentences.zh: 閏月，鞏唐羌寇隴西，遂及三輔，燒園陵，殺掠吏民。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, the Gongtang Qiang raided Longxi, reached the Three Assistants, burned the park tombs, and killed and plundered officials and people.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, the Gongtang Qiang raided Longxi, reached the Three Assistants, burned the park tombs, and killed and plundered officials and people.

sentences.zh: 二月，丁巳，有星孛於營室。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingsi, a comet appeared in the Lodgings.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingsi day, a comet appeared in the Lodgings.

sentences.zh: 三月，上巳，大將軍商大會賓客，宴於雒水；

translations.literal: In the third month, on Shangsi, Grand General-in-Chief Shang greatly gathered guests and feasted at the Luo River;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on Shangsi, Grand General-in-Chief Liang Shang greatly gathered guests and feasted at the Luo River;

sentences.zh: 酒闌，繼以《韭露之歌》。

translations.literal: when the wine was ending they followed with the "Song of Leek Dew."
translations.idiomatic: when the wine was ending they followed with the "Song of Leek Dew."

sentences.zh: 從事中郎周舉聞之，歎曰：「此所謂哀樂失時，非其所也，殃將及乎！

translations.literal: Attendant Gentleman Zhou Ju heard this and sighed, saying: "This is what is called joy and mourning out of season, not in their proper place—calamity will reach us!
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Gentleman Zhou Ju heard this and sighed, saying, "This is what is called joy and mourning out of season, not in their proper place—calamity will reach us!

sentences.zh: 武都太守趙沖追擊鞏唐羌，斬首四百餘級，降二千餘人。

translations.literal: Administrator of Wudou Zhao Chong pursued the Gongtang Qiang, took more than four hundred heads, and received more than two thousand surrenders.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator of Wudou Zhao Chong pursued the Gongtang Qiang, took more than four hundred heads, and received more than two thousand surrenders.

sentences.zh: 詔沖督河西四郡兵為節度。

translations.literal: An edict made Chong supervise the armies of the four Hexi commanderies as coordinator.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Zhao Chong supervise the armies of the four Hexi commanderies as coordinator.

sentences.zh: 安定上計掾皇甫規上疏曰：「臣比年以來，數陳便宜：羌戎未動，策其將反；

translations.literal: Anding's reporting clerk Huangfu Gui submitted a memorial, saying: "Your servant in recent years has repeatedly set forth timely proposals: before the Qiang and Rong moved, I predicted they would rebel;
translations.idiomatic: Anding's reporting clerk Huangfu Gui submitted a memorial, saying, "Your servant in recent years has repeatedly set forth timely proposals. Before the Qiang and Rong moved, I predicted they would rebel;

sentences.zh: 馬賢始出，知其必敗。

translations.literal: when Ma Xian first went out, I knew he would certainly fail.
translations.idiomatic: when Ma Xian first went out, I knew he would certainly fail.

sentences.zh: 誤中之言，在可考校。

translations.literal: Words that hit by mistake are subject to verification.
translations.idiomatic: Words that hit by mistake are subject to verification.

sentences.zh: 臣每惟賢等擁眾四年，未有成功，縣師之費，且百億計，出於平民，回入奸吏。

translations.literal: Your servant often reflects that Xian and others have held armies for four years without success; expenses for troops in the field exceed ten billion, taken from common people and circling back into corrupt officials.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant often reflects that Ma Xian and others have held armies for four years without success. Expenses for troops in the field exceed ten billion, taken from common people and circling back into corrupt officials.

sentences.zh: 故江湖之人，群為盜賊，青、徐荒饑，襁負流散。

translations.literal: Therefore people of the rivers and lakes band together as bandits; Qing and Xu suffer famine and hunger, carrying infants in swaddling clothes and scattering in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore people of the rivers and lakes band together as bandits. Qing and Xu suffer famine and hunger, carrying infants in swaddling clothes and scattering in flight.

sentences.zh: 夫羌戎潰叛，不由承平，皆因邊將失於綏御，乘常守安則加侵暴，苟競小利則致大害，微勝則虛張首級，軍敗則隱匿不言。

translations.literal: The Qiang and Rong's collapse and rebellion do not come from long peace—all stem from frontier generals failing in pacification and control: when taking advantage of routine security they add invasion and violence; when competing for petty gain they bring great harm; slight victory they inflate with false head counts, defeat they hide and do not report.
translations.idiomatic: The Qiang and Rong's collapse and rebellion do not come from long peace—all stem from frontier generals failing in pacification and control. When taking advantage of routine security they add invasion and violence; when competing for petty gain they bring great harm. Slight victory they inflate with false head counts; defeat they hide and do not report.

sentences.zh: 軍士勞怨，困於猾吏，進不得快戰以徼功，退不得溫飽以全命，餓死溝渠，暴骨中原；

translations.literal: Soldiers labor and resent, trapped by cunning clerks—advancing they cannot fight swiftly to win merit, retreating they cannot get warmth and food to preserve life; they starve dead in ditches and drains, bones exposed in the central plains;
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers labor and resent, trapped by cunning clerks—advancing they cannot fight swiftly to win merit, retreating they cannot get warmth and food to preserve life. They starve dead in ditches and drains, bones exposed in the central plains;

sentences.zh: 徒見王師之出，不聞振旅之聲。

translations.literal: one only sees the royal army go forth, never hears the sound of troops returning triumphant.
translations.idiomatic: one only sees the royal army go forth, never hears the sound of troops returning triumphant.

sentences.zh: 酋豪泣血，驚懼生變，是以安不能久，叛則經年，臣所以搏手扣心而增歎者也！

translations.literal: Chieftains weep blood, startled fear breeds change—thus peace cannot last long and rebellion lasts years; this is why your servant claps his hands and strikes his heart with added sighs!
translations.idiomatic: Chieftains weep blood, startled fear breeds change—thus peace cannot last long and rebellion lasts years. This is why your servant claps his hands and strikes his heart with added sighs!

sentences.zh: 願假臣兩營、二郡屯列坐食之兵五千，出其不意，與趙沖共相首尾。

translations.literal: Your servant wishes to be lent five thousand men from two camps and two commanderies who sit and eat at their stations, strike with surprise, and coordinate head and tail with Zhao Chong.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant wishes to be lent five thousand men from two camps and two commanderies who sit and eat at their stations, strike with surprise, and coordinate head and tail with Zhao Chong.

sentences.zh: 土地山谷，臣所曉習；

translations.literal: The land's mountains and valleys your servant knows well;
translations.idiomatic: The land's mountains and valleys your servant knows well;

sentences.zh: 兵勢巧便，臣已更之；

translations.literal: military formations' cunning and convenience your servant has already revised;
translations.idiomatic: military formations' cunning and convenience your servant has already revised;

sentences.zh: 可不煩方寸之印，尺帛之賜，高可以滌患，下可以納降。

translations.literal: without troubling an inch-square seal or a foot of silk reward—above it can wash away calamity, below it can receive surrender.
translations.idiomatic: without troubling an inch-square seal or a foot of silk reward—above it can wash away calamity, below it can receive surrender.

sentences.zh: 若謂臣年少、官輕，不足用者，凡諸敗將，非官爵之不高，年齒之不邁。

translations.literal: If you say your servant is young and his office light and not sufficient to use—for all the defeated generals, it was not that rank was not high or years not advanced.
translations.idiomatic: If you say your servant is young and his office light and not sufficient to use—for all the defeated generals, it was not that rank was not high or years not advanced.

sentences.zh: 臣不勝至誠，沒死自陳！

translations.literal: Your servant cannot overcome utmost sincerity and offers this even unto death!
translations.idiomatic: Your servant cannot overcome utmost sincerity and offers this even unto death!

sentences.zh: 」帝不能用。

translations.literal: " The emperor could not employ him.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor could not employ him.

sentences.zh: 庚子，司空郭虔免。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Minister of Works Guo Qian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Minister of Works Guo Qian was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以太僕趙戒為司空。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Grand Master of Transport Zhao Jie was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Grand Master of Transport Zhao Jie was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏，使匈奴中郎將張耽、度遼將軍馬續率鮮卑到谷城，擊烏桓於通天山，大破之。

translations.literal: In summer, the Xiongnu Colonel Zhang Dan and Crossing-the-Desert General Ma Xu led the Xianbei to Gucheng and attacked the Wuhuan at Mount Tongtian, routing them greatly.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the Xiongnu Colonel Zhang Dan and Crossing-the-Desert General Ma Xu led the Xianbei to Gucheng and attacked the Wuhuan at Mount Tongtian, routing them greatly.

sentences.zh: 鞏唐羌寇北地。

translations.literal: The Gongtang Qiang raided Beidi.
translations.idiomatic: The Gongtang Qiang raided Beidi.

sentences.zh: 北地太守賈福與趙衝擊之，不利。

translations.literal: Beidi Administrator Jia Fu with Zhao Chong attacked them but with unfavorable result.
translations.idiomatic: Beidi Administrator Jia Fu with Zhao Chong attacked them but with unfavorable result.

sentences.zh: 秋，八月，乘氏忠侯梁商病篤，敕子冀等曰：「吾生無以輔益朝廷，死何可耗費帑藏！

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, Loyal Marquis of Chengshi Liang Shang was gravely ill and instructed his sons Ji and the others, saying: "In life I had nothing by which to aid and benefit the court—in death how can I waste the treasury!
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, Loyal Marquis of Chengshi Liang Shang was gravely ill and instructed his sons Ji and the others, saying, "In life I had nothing by which to aid and benefit the court—in death how can I waste the treasury!

sentences.zh: 衣衾、飯含、玉匣、珠貝之屬，何益朽骨！

translations.literal: Garments, grave offerings, jade cases, pearls and shells—what good to rotted bones!
translations.idiomatic: Garments, grave offerings, jade cases, pearls and shells—what good to rotted bones!

sentences.zh: 百僚勞擾，紛華道路，只增塵垢耳。

translations.literal: A hundred officials labor and disturb, splendor fills the roads—this only adds dust and filth.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred officials labor and disturb, splendor fills the roads—this only adds dust and filth.

sentences.zh: 宜皆辭之。

translations.literal: You should all decline these."
translations.idiomatic: You should all decline these."

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，薨；

translations.literal: " On bingchen, he died;
translations.idiomatic: " On bingchen day, he died;

sentences.zh: 帝親臨喪。

translations.literal: the emperor personally attended the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally attended the mourning.

sentences.zh: 諸子欲從其誨，朝廷不聽，賜以東園秘器、銀鏤、黃腸、玉匣。

translations.literal: The sons wished to follow his teaching but the court would not hear it and bestowed the Eastern Garden secret coffin ware, silver inlay, yellow cypress, and jade case.
translations.idiomatic: The sons wished to follow his teaching but the court would not hear it and bestowed the Eastern Garden secret coffin ware, silver inlay, yellow cypress, and jade case.

sentences.zh: 及葬，賜輕車、介士，中宮親送。

translations.literal: At the burial they were granted light carriages and armed guards; the inner palace personally escorted.
translations.idiomatic: At the burial they were granted light carriages and armed guards. The inner palace personally escorted.

sentences.zh: 帝至宣陽亭，瞻望車騎。

translations.literal: The emperor went to Xuanyang Pavilion and gazed upon the carriage and escort.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went to Xuanyang Pavilion and gazed upon the carriage and escort.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以河南尹、乘氏侯梁冀為大將軍，冀弟侍中不疑為河南伊。

translations.literal: On renxu, Henan Intendant and Marquis of Chengshi Liang Ji was made Grand General-in-Chief, and Ji's younger brother Palace Attendant Buyi was made Intendant of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Henan Intendant and Marquis of Chengshi Liang Ji was made Grand General-in-Chief, and Ji's younger brother Palace Attendant Buyi was made Intendant of Henan.

sentences.zh: 臣光曰：成帝不能選任賢俊，委政舅家，可謂暗矣；

translations.literal: Subject Guang said: Emperor Cheng could not select and appoint worthy and talented men, entrusted government to the maternal kin—it may be called dim;
translations.idiomatic: Sima Guang remarks: Emperor Cheng could not select and appoint worthy and talented men and entrusted government to the maternal kin—it may be called dim;

sentences.zh: 猶知王立之不材，棄而不用。

translations.literal: yet he still knew Wang Li's lack of ability and discarded him without using him.
translations.idiomatic: yet he still knew Wang Li's lack of ability and discarded him without using him.

sentences.zh: 順帝援大柄，授之後族，梁冀頑嚚凶暴，著於平昔，而使之繼父之位，終於悖逆，蕩覆漢室；

translations.literal: Emperor Shun took up the great handle and gave it to the empress's clan—Liang Ji was obstinate, foolish, fierce, and violent, evident from the past—yet had him succeed his father's position, ending in perversity and overturning the Han house;
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shun took up the great handle and gave it to the empress's clan. Liang Ji was obstinate, foolish, fierce, and violent, evident from the past, yet was made to succeed his father's position, ending in perversity and overturning the Han house;

sentences.zh: 校於成帝，暗又甚焉！

translations.literal: Compared with Emperor Cheng, he was even dimmer!
translations.idiomatic: Compared with Emperor Cheng, he was even dimmer!

sentences.zh: 初，梁商病篤，帝親臨幸，問以遺言。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Liang Shang was gravely ill, the emperor personally visited and asked his last words.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Liang Shang was gravely ill, the emperor personally visited and asked his last words.

sentences.zh: 對曰：「臣從事中郎周舉，清高忠正，可重任也。

translations.literal: He replied: "Your servant's Attendant Gentleman Zhou Ju is pure, lofty, loyal, and upright—he may be heavily entrusted.
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "Your servant's Attendant Gentleman Zhou Ju is pure, lofty, loyal, and upright—he may be heavily entrusted.

sentences.zh: 」由是拜舉諫議大夫。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Ju was appointed Grandee Remonstrator.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon Zhou Ju was appointed Grandee Remonstrator.

sentences.zh: 九月，諸羌寇武威。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the various Qiang raided Wuwei.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the various Qiang raided Wuwei.

sentences.zh: 辛亥晦，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the last day of the month, xinhai, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the month, xinhai day, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，癸丑，以羌寇充斥，涼部震恐，復徙安定居扶風，北地居馮翊。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on guichou, because Qiang raiders filled the region and Liang province trembled in fear, Anding was again moved to lodge in Fufeng and Beidi in Fengyi.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on guichou day, because Qiang raiders filled the region and Liang province trembled in fear, Anding was again moved to lodge in Fufeng and Beidi in Fengyi.

sentences.zh: 十一月，庚子，以執金吾張喬行車騎將軍事，將兵萬五千人屯三輔。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengzi, Chief Commandant of Justice Zhang Qiao was made to act as General of Chariots and Cavalry Affairs, leading fifteen thousand troops garrisoned in the Three Assistants.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day, Chief Commandant of Justice Zhang Qiao was made to act as General of Chariots and Cavalry Affairs, leading fifteen thousand troops garrisoned in the Three Assistants.

sentences.zh: 荊州盜賊起，彌年不定；

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Jing province and for a year were not settled;
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Jing province and for a year were not settled;

sentences.zh: 以大將軍從事中郎李固為荊州刺史。

translations.literal: Attendant Gentleman of the Grand General-in-Chief Li Gu was made Inspector of Jing province.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Gentleman of the Grand General-in-Chief Li Gu was made Inspector of Jing province.

sentences.zh: 固到，遣吏勞問境內，赦寇盜前釁，與之更始。

translations.literal: When Gu arrived he sent officials to comfort and inquire within the borders, pardoned the bandits' prior offenses, and gave them a fresh start.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Gu arrived he sent officials to comfort and inquire within the borders, pardoned the bandits' prior offenses, and gave them a fresh start.

sentences.zh: 於是賊帥夏密等率其魁黨六百餘人自縛歸首，固皆原之，遣還，使自相招集，開示威法；

translations.literal: Thereupon the bandit chief Xia Mi and others led more than six hundred chiefs and followers to bind themselves and surrender; Gu all pardoned them, sent them back, had them gather one another, and opened and displayed the laws of authority;
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the bandit chief Xia Mi and others led more than six hundred chiefs and followers to bind themselves and surrender. Li Gu all pardoned them, sent them back, had them gather one another, and opened and displayed the laws of authority;

sentences.zh: 半歲間，餘類悉降，州內清平。

translations.literal: within half a year the remaining groups all surrendered and the province was clear and at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Within half a year the remaining groups all surrendered and the province was clear and at peace.

sentences.zh: 奏南陽太守高賜等臧穢；

translations.literal: He memorialized that Administrator of Nanyang Gao Ci and others were corrupt;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that Administrator of Nanyang Gao Ci and others were corrupt;

sentences.zh: 賜等重賂大將軍梁冀，冀為之千里移檄，而固持之愈急，冀遂徙固為泰山太守。

translations.literal: Ci and others heavily bribed Grand General Liang Ji; Ji for them sent a proclamation a thousand li away, yet Gu held firm ever more urgently, and Ji thereupon transferred Gu to be Administrator of Taishan.
translations.idiomatic: Ci and others heavily bribed Grand General Liang Ji. Ji for them sent a proclamation a thousand li away, yet Li Gu held firm ever more urgently, and Ji thereupon transferred Li Gu to be Administrator of Taishan.

sentences.zh: 時泰山盜賊屯聚歷年，郡兵常千人追討，不能制；

translations.literal: At the time bandits in Taishan had gathered for years; commandery troops, often a thousand men in pursuit, could not control them;
translations.idiomatic: At the time bandits in Taishan had gathered for years. Commandery troops, often a thousand men in pursuit, could not control them;

sentences.zh: 固到，悉罷遣歸農，但選留任戰者百餘人，以恩信招誘之。

translations.literal: When Gu arrived, he dismissed all and sent them back to farming, selecting only a little more than a hundred fit for battle to remain, and with kindness and trust summoned and enticed the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Gu arrived, he dismissed all the troops and sent them back to farming, selecting only a little more than a hundred fit for battle to remain, and with kindness and trust summoned and enticed the bandits.

sentences.zh: 未滿歲，賊皆弭散。

translations.literal: Before a full year had passed, the bandits all dispersed and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Before a full year had passed, the bandits all dispersed and submitted.

sentences.zh: 春，正月，癸巳，赦天下，改元。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on guisi day, amnestied the realm and changed the reign title.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on guisi day, the realm was amnestied and the reign title was changed.

sentences.zh: 秋，八月，南匈奴句龍吾斯與薁鞬、台耆等復反，寇掠並部。

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, the Southern Xiongnu Goulong Wusi together with Wujian, Taiqi, and others again rebelled and raided Bing province.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, the Southern Xiongnu Goulong Wusi together with Wujian, Taiqi, and others again rebelled and raided Bing province.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遺侍中河內杜喬、周舉、守光祿大夫周栩、馮羨、魏郡欒巴、張綱、郭遵、劉班分行州郡，表賢良，顯忠勤；

translations.literal: On dingmao day, sent Palace Attendant Du Qiao of Henei, Zhou Ju, Acting Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Zhou Xu, Feng Xian, Luan Ba of Wei commandery, Zhang Gang, Guo Zun, and Liu Ban to tour the commanderies and states separately, to memorialize the worthy and good, and display loyalty and diligence;
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, Palace Attendant Du Qiao of Henei, Zhou Ju, Acting Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Zhou Xu, Feng Xian, Luan Ba of Wei commandery, Zhang Gang, Guo Zun, and Liu Ban were sent to tour the commanderies and states separately, to memorialize the worthy and good, and display loyalty and diligence;

sentences.zh: 其貪污有罪者，刺史、二千石驛馬上之，墨綬以下便輒收舉。

translations.literal: as for the corrupt and guilty, governors and two-thousand-bushel officials were to report them by relay horse, and those below black seal were at once to be arrested and impeached.
translations.idiomatic: as for the corrupt and guilty, governors and two-thousand-bushel officials were to report them by relay horse, and those below black seal were at once to be arrested and impeached.

sentences.zh: 喬等受命之部，張綱獨埋其車輪於雒陽都亭，曰：「豺狼當路，安問狐狸！

translations.literal: Qiao and the others received the command and went to their regions; Zhang Gang alone buried his carriage wheels at the Luoyang capital post station, saying: "When jackals and wolves block the road, why ask about foxes!
translations.idiomatic: Qiao and the others received the command and went to their regions. Zhang Gang alone buried his carriage wheels at the Luoyang capital post station, saying, "When jackals and wolves block the road, why ask about foxes!

sentences.zh: 」遂劾奏：「大將軍冀、河南尹不疑，以外戚蒙恩，居阿衡之任，而專肆貪叨，縱恣無極，多樹諂諛以害忠良，誠天威所不赦，大辟所宜加也。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he impeached and memorialized: "Grand General Ji and Intendant of Henan Bu Yi, as maternal kin receiving grace, holding the task of supporting the balance, yet exclusively indulging greed, dissolute without limit, planting many flatterers to harm the loyal and good—truly what heaven's majesty does not pardon and what the great execution should be applied to.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he impeached and memorialized, "Grand General Ji and Intendant of Henan Bu Yi, as maternal kin receiving grace, holding the task of supporting the balance, yet exclusively indulging greed, dissolute without limit, planting many flatterers to harm the loyal and good—truly what heaven's majesty does not pardon and what the great execution should be applied to.

sentences.zh: 謹條其無君之心十五事，斯皆臣子所切齒者也。

translations.literal: " Your servant respectfully lists fifteen matters of his heart without a ruler—all these are what ministers and sons gnash their teeth at.
translations.idiomatic: " Your servant respectfully lists fifteen matters of his heart without a ruler—all these are what ministers and sons gnash their teeth at.

sentences.zh: 」書御，京師震竦。

translations.literal: " The memorial reached the throne; the capital trembled in awe.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial reached the throne. The capital trembled in awe.

sentences.zh: 時皇后寵方盛，諸梁姻族滿朝，帝雖知綱言直，不能用也。

translations.literal: At the time the empress's favor was flourishing; all the Liang affinal kin filled the court. Though the emperor knew Gang's words were straight, he could not use them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the empress's favor was flourishing and all the Liang affinal kin filled the court. Though the emperor knew Gang's words were straight, he could not use them.

sentences.zh: 杜喬至冶金兗州，表奏泰山太守李固政為天下第一，上征固為將作大匠。

translations.literal: Du Qiao reached Yanzhou and memorialized that Administrator of Taishan Li Gu's government was first under heaven; the emperor summoned Gu to be Master of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Du Qiao reached Yanzhou and memorialized that Administrator of Taishan Li Gu's government was first under heaven. The emperor summoned Li Gu to be Master of Works.

sentences.zh: 八使所劾奏，多梁冀及宦者親黨；

translations.literal: What the eight envoys impeached and memorialized was mostly Liang Ji and the eunuchs' kin and partisans;
translations.idiomatic: What the eight envoys impeached and memorialized was mostly Liang Ji and the eunuchs' kin and partisans;

sentences.zh: 互為請救，事皆寢遏。

translations.literal: they pleaded for one another's rescue, and all matters were suppressed and blocked.
translations.idiomatic: they pleaded for one another's rescue, and all matters were suppressed and blocked.

sentences.zh: 侍御史河南種暠疾之，復行案舉。

translations.literal: Attending Clerk Zhong Hao of Henan hated this and again carried out investigation and impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: Attending Clerk Zhong Hao of Henan hated this and again carried out investigation and impeachment.

sentences.zh: 廷尉吳雄、將作大匠李固亦上言：「八使所糾，宜急誅罰。

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Wu Xiong and Master of Works Li Gu also submitted words: "What the eight envoys impeached should urgently be executed and punished.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Justice Wu Xiong and Master of Works Li Gu also submitted words, "What the eight envoys impeached should urgently be executed and punished.

sentences.zh: 」帝乃更下八使奏章，令考正其罪。

translations.literal: " The emperor thereupon again sent down the eight envoys' memorials and ordered examination and correction of their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor thereupon again sent down the eight envoys' memorials and ordered examination and correction of their crimes.

sentences.zh: 梁冀恨張綱，思有以中傷之。

translations.literal: Liang Ji hated Zhang Gang and sought some means to strike him within.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Ji hated Zhang Gang and sought some means to strike him within.

sentences.zh: 時廣陵賊張嬰寇亂揚、徐間積十餘年，二千石不能制，冀乃以綱為廣陵太守。

translations.literal: At the time the bandit of Guangling Zhang Ying had raided and disturbed Yang and Xu for more than ten years; two-thousand-bushel officials could not control him, and Ji thereupon made Gang Administrator of Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the bandit of Guangling Zhang Ying had raided and disturbed Yang and Xu for more than ten years. Two-thousand-bushel officials could not control him, and Ji thereupon made Gang Administrator of Guangling.

sentences.zh: 前太守率多求兵馬，綱獨請單車之職。

translations.literal: Former administrators mostly requested troops and horses; Gang alone requested the duty with a single carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Former administrators mostly requested troops and horses. Gang alone requested the duty with a single carriage.

sentences.zh: 既到，逕詣嬰壘門；

translations.literal: When he had arrived, he went straight to Ying's camp gate;
translations.idiomatic: When he had arrived, he went straight to Ying's camp gate;

sentences.zh: 嬰大驚，遽走閉壘。

translations.literal: Ying was greatly alarmed and hastily ran to shut the camp.
translations.idiomatic: Ying was greatly alarmed and hastily ran to shut the camp.

sentences.zh: 綱於門外罷遣吏兵，獨留所親者十餘人，以書喻嬰，請與相見。

translations.literal: Gang outside the gate dismissed clerks and soldiers, keeping only a little more than ten of his intimates, and with a letter instructed Ying, requesting to meet face to face.
translations.idiomatic: Gang outside the gate dismissed clerks and soldiers, keeping only a little more than ten of his intimates, and with a letter instructed Ying, requesting to meet face to face.

sentences.zh: 嬰見綱至誠，乃出拜謁。

translations.literal: Ying, seeing Gang's utmost sincerity, then came out to bow and call on him.
translations.idiomatic: Ying, seeing Gang's utmost sincerity, then came out to bow and call on him.

sentences.zh: 綱延置上坐，譬之曰：「前後二千石多肆貪暴，故致公等懷憤相聚。

translations.literal: Gang received him and set him in the upper seat, admonishing him, saying: "Former and later two-thousand-bushel officials mostly indulged greed and violence, and so caused you gentlemen to harbor resentment and gather together.
translations.idiomatic: Gang received him and set him in the upper seat, admonishing him, saying, "Former and later two-thousand-bushel officials mostly indulged greed and violence, and so caused you gentlemen to harbor resentment and gather together.

sentences.zh: 二千石信有罪矣，然為之者又非義也。

translations.literal: " The two-thousand-bushel officials truly have offense, yet what you do is also not righteous.
translations.idiomatic: " The two-thousand-bushel officials truly have offense, yet what you do is also not righteous.

sentences.zh: 今主上仁聖，欲以文德服叛，故遣太守來，思以爵祿相榮，不願以刑罰相加，今誠轉禍為福之時也。

translations.literal: " Now the sovereign is benevolent and sage, wishing with civil virtue to subdue rebels, and so sent the administrator to come, thinking to honor you with rank and salary and not wishing to add punishments—now is truly the time to turn disaster into blessing.
translations.idiomatic: " Now the sovereign is benevolent and sage, wishing with civil virtue to subdue rebels, and so sent the administrator to come, thinking to honor you with rank and salary and not wishing to add punishments—now is truly the time to turn disaster into blessing.

sentences.zh: 若聞義不服，天子赫然震怒，荊、揚、兗、豫大兵雲合，身首橫分，血嗣俱絕。

translations.literal: " If on hearing righteousness you do not submit, the Son of Heaven will blaze in anger; great armies of Jing, Yang, Yan, and Yu will gather like clouds, bodies and heads cut apart, blood descendants all extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: " If on hearing righteousness you do not submit, the Son of Heaven will blaze in anger. Great armies of Jing, Yang, Yan, and Yu will gather like clouds, bodies and heads cut apart, blood descendants all extinguished.

sentences.zh: 二者利害，公其深計之！

translations.literal: " Of the two, benefit and harm—you gentlemen should deeply calculate them!
translations.idiomatic: " Of the two, benefit and harm—you gentlemen should deeply calculate them!

sentences.zh: 」嬰聞，泣下曰：「荒裔愚民，不能自通朝廷，不堪侵枉，遂復相聚偷生，若魚游釜中，知其不可久，且以喘息須臾間耳！

translations.literal: " Ying on hearing wept and said: "Your servant is a foolish man of the wild borderlands, unable to reach the court on his own, unable to bear oppression and wrong, and so again gathered to steal life, like fish swimming in a cauldron—knowing it cannot last long, only gasping for breath in a brief moment!
translations.idiomatic: " Ying on hearing wept and said, "Your servant is a foolish man of the wild borderlands, unable to reach the court on his own, unable to bear oppression and wrong, and so again gathered to steal life, like fish swimming in a cauldron—knowing it cannot last long, only gasping for breath in a brief moment!

sentences.zh: 今聞明府之言，乃嬰等更生之辰也！

translations.literal: " Now on hearing the enlightened prefect's words, this is the hour when Ying and the rest are born again!
translations.idiomatic: " Now on hearing the enlightened prefect's words, this is the hour when Ying and the rest are born again!

sentences.zh: 」乃辭還營。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he took leave and returned to camp.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he took leave and returned to camp.

sentences.zh: 明日，將所部萬餘人與妻子面縛歸降。

translations.literal: The next day he led his following of more than ten thousand men, with wives and children, bound face-forward and came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he led his following of more than ten thousand men, with wives and children, bound face-forward and came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 綱單車入嬰壘，大會，置酒為樂，散遣部眾，任從所之；

translations.literal: Gang with a single carriage entered Ying's camp, held a great assembly, set out wine for joy, and dispersed and sent off the troops, letting them go where they wished;
translations.idiomatic: Gang with a single carriage entered Ying's camp, held a great assembly, set out wine for joy, and dispersed and sent off the troops, letting them go where they wished;

sentences.zh: 親為卜居宅、相田疇；

translations.literal: he personally chose dwelling sites and surveyed fields for them;
translations.idiomatic: he personally chose dwelling sites and surveyed fields for them;

sentences.zh: 子弟欲為吏者，皆引召之。

translations.literal: sons and younger brothers who wished to become officials were all summoned and appointed.
translations.idiomatic: sons and younger brothers who wished to become officials were all summoned and appointed.

sentences.zh: 人情悅服，南州晏然。

translations.literal: Human hearts were pleased and submitted; the southern province was peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Human hearts were pleased and submitted. The southern province was peaceful.

sentences.zh: 朝廷論功當封，梁冀遏之。

translations.literal: The court deliberated on merit and he should have been enfeoffed, but Liang Ji blocked it.
translations.idiomatic: The court deliberated on merit and he should have been enfeoffed, but Liang Ji blocked it.

sentences.zh: 在郡一歲，卒；

translations.literal: After one year in the commandery he died;
translations.idiomatic: After one year in the commandery he died;

sentences.zh: 張嬰等五百餘人為之制服行喪，送到犍為，負土成墳。

translations.literal: Zhang Ying and more than five hundred others wore mourning for him and conducted the funeral, escorting him to Qianwei and piling earth to make his mound.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ying and more than five hundred others wore mourning for him and conducted the funeral, escorting him to Qianwei and piling earth to make his mound.

sentences.zh: 詔拜其子續為郎中，賜錢百萬。

translations.literal: An edict appointed his son Xu as Gentleman of the Palace, bestowing a million cash.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed his son Xu as Gentleman of the Palace, bestowing a million cash.

sentences.zh: 是時，二千石長吏有能政者，有雒陽令渤海任峻、冀州刺史京兆蘇章、膠東相陳留吳祐。

translations.literal: At the time among chief officials of two thousand bushels who had able government were Magistrate of Luoyang Ren Jun of Bohai, Governor of Ji Su Zhang of Jingzhao, and Chancellor of Jiaodong Wu You of Chenliu.
translations.idiomatic: At the time among chief officials of two thousand bushels who had able government were Magistrate of Luoyang Ren Jun of Bohai, Governor of Ji Su Zhang of Jingzhao, and Chancellor of Jiaodong Wu You of Chenliu.

sentences.zh: 雒陽令自王渙之後，皆不稱職。

translations.literal: Magistrates of Luoyang since Wang Huan had none been fit for their duties.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrates of Luoyang since Wang Huan had none been fit for their duties.

sentences.zh: 峻能選用文武吏，各盡其用，發奸不旋踵，民間不畏吏，其威禁猛於渙，而文理政教不如也。

translations.literal: Jun could select and employ civil and military clerks, each fulfilling his use; exposing wickedness without turning the heel—the people in the lanes did not fear clerks. His authority and prohibitions were fiercer than Huan's, yet in culture, principle, government, and instruction he was not equal.
translations.idiomatic: Jun could select and employ civil and military clerks, each fulfilling his use, exposing wickedness without turning the heel—the people in the lanes did not fear clerks. His authority and prohibitions were fiercer than Huan's, yet in culture, principle, government, and instruction he was not equal.

sentences.zh: 章為冀州刺史，有故人為清河太守，章行部，欲案其奸臧，乃主太守為設酒餚，陳平生之好甚歡。

translations.literal: Zhang was Governor of Ji; an old friend was Administrator of Qinghe. When Zhang toured the department and wished to investigate his corruption, the host administrator set out wine and food for him and spoke of their lifelong friendship very pleasantly.
translations.idiomatic: Su Zhang was Governor of Ji. An old friend was Administrator of Qinghe. When Zhang toured the department and wished to investigate his corruption, the host administrator set out wine and food for him and spoke of their lifelong friendship very pleasantly.

sentences.zh: 太守喜曰：「人皆有一天，我獨有二天！

translations.literal: The administrator rejoiced and said: "Others all have one heaven; I alone have two heavens!
translations.idiomatic: The administrator rejoiced and said, "Others all have one heaven. I alone have two heavens!

sentences.zh: 」章曰：「今夕蘇孺文與故人飲者，私恩也；

translations.literal: " Zhang said: "Tonight Su Ruwen drinking with an old friend is private favor;
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang said, "Tonight Su Ruwen drinking with an old friend is private favor;

sentences.zh: 明日冀州刺史案事者，公法也。

translations.literal: " tomorrow the Governor of Ji investigating the case is public law.
translations.idiomatic: " tomorrow the Governor of Ji investigating the case is public law.

sentences.zh: 」遂舉正其罪，州境肅然。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he impeached and corrected his crime; within the province all was orderly.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he impeached and corrected his crime. Within the province all was orderly.

sentences.zh: 後以摧折權豪忤旨，坐免。

translations.literal: Later because he crushed the powerful and great and offended the imperial will, he was dismissed by offense.
translations.idiomatic: Later because he crushed the powerful and great and offended the imperial will, he was dismissed by offense.

sentences.zh: 時天下日敝，民多愁苦，論者日夜稱章，朝廷遂不能復用也。

translations.literal: At the time the realm daily declined and the people had much sorrow and suffering; debaters day and night praised Zhang, yet the court in the end could not employ him again.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the realm daily declined and the people had much sorrow and suffering. Debaters day and night praised Zhang, yet the court in the end could not employ him again.

sentences.zh: 祐為膠東相，政崇仁簡，民不忍欺。

translations.literal: You was Chancellor of Jiaodong; his government honored benevolence and simplicity, and the people could not bear to deceive him.
translations.idiomatic: Wu You was Chancellor of Jiaodong. His government honored benevolence and simplicity, and the people could not bear to deceive him.

sentences.zh: 嗇夫孫性，私賦民錢，市衣以進其父，父得而怒曰：「有君如是，何忍欺之！

translations.literal: Revenue Officer Sun Xing privately levied the people's money, bought clothes, and presented them to his father. The father on receiving them angrily said: "With a ruler like this, how can one bear to deceive him!
translations.idiomatic: Revenue Officer Sun Xing privately levied the people's money, bought clothes, and presented them to his father. The father on receiving them angrily said, "With a ruler like this, how can one bear to deceive him!

sentences.zh: 」促歸伏罪。

translations.literal: " He urged him to return and submit to punishment.
translations.idiomatic: " He urged him to return and submit to punishment.

sentences.zh: 性慚懼詣閣，持衣自首。

translations.literal: Xing in shame and fear went to the gate, holding the clothes to confess.
translations.idiomatic: Xing in shame and fear went to the gate, holding the clothes to confess.

sentences.zh: 祐屏左右問其故，性具談父言。

translations.literal: You dismissed attendants and asked the reason; Xing fully related his father's words.
translations.idiomatic: You dismissed attendants and asked the reason. Xing fully related his father's words.

sentences.zh: 祐曰：「掾以親故受污穢之名，所謂『觀過斯知仁矣。

translations.literal: You said: "As a clerk you received a filthy name for kin's sake—what is called 'in observing faults one knows benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: You said, "As a clerk you received a filthy name for kin's sake—what is called 'in observing faults one knows benevolence.

sentences.zh: 』」使歸謝其父，還以衣遺之。

translations.literal: "'" He had him return to thank his father and gave back the clothes to him.
translations.idiomatic: "'" He had him return to thank his father and gave back the clothes to him.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，辛未，太尉桓焉、司徒劉壽免。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on xinwei day, Grand Commandant Huan Yan and Minister over the Masses Liu Shou were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, on xinwei day, Grand Commandant Huan Yan and Minister over the Masses Liu Shou were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 罕羌邑落五千餘戶詣趙沖降，唯燒何種據參絲未下。

translations.literal: Qiang settlements of Han numbered more than five thousand households who came to Zhao Chong to surrender; only the Shaohe tribe held Cansi and had not submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Qiang settlements of Han numbered more than five thousand households who came to Zhao Chong to surrender. Only the Shaohe tribe held Cansi and had not submitted.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，罷張喬軍屯。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, Zhang Qiao's encamped army was disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Zhang Qiao's encamped army was disbanded.

sentences.zh: 十一月，壬午，以司隸校尉下邳趙峻為太尉，大司農胡廣為司徒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renwu day, made Colonel of the Metropolitan Area Zhao Jun of Xiapi Grand Commandant and Grand Minister of Agriculture Hu Guang Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renwu day, Colonel of the Metropolitan Area Zhao Jun of Xiapi was made Grand Commandant and Grand Minister of Agriculture Hu Guang was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，庚戌，護羌校尉趙沖與漢陽太守張貢擊燒當羌於參絲，破之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on gengxu day, Colonel Protector of the Qiang Zhao Chong together with Administrator of Hanyang Zhang Gong attacked the Shaohe Qiang at Cansi and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, on gengxu day, Colonel Protector of the Qiang Zhao Chong together with Administrator of Hanyang Zhang Gong attacked the Shaohe Qiang at Cansi and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 六月，丙寅，立南匈奴守義王兜樓儲為呼蘭若屍逐就單于。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingyin day, established King of Upholding Righteousness of the Southern Xiongnu Dou Louchu as Chanyu Hulan Ruoshizhujiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingyin day, King of Upholding Righteousness of the Southern Xiongnu Dou Louchu was established as Chanyu Hulan Ruoshizhujiu.

sentences.zh: 時兜樓儲在京師，上親臨軒授璽綬，引上殿，賜車馬、器服、金帛甚厚。

translations.literal: At the time Dou Louchu was in the capital; the emperor personally came to the hall to bestow the seal cord, led him up the hall, and bestowed carriage, horse, vessels, robes, gold, and silk very richly.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Dou Louchu was in the capital. The emperor personally came to the hall to bestow the seal cord, led him up the hall, and bestowed carriage, horse, vessels, robes, gold, and silk very richly.

sentences.zh: 詔太常、大鴻臚與諸國侍子於廣陽城門外祖會，饗賜、作樂、角抵、百戲。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Minister of Ceremonies and the Grand Herald together with the attendant sons of the various states to meet him in farewell outside the Guangyang city gate, with feasting, bestowals, music, grappling, and the hundred entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Minister of Ceremonies and the Grand Herald together with the attendant sons of the various states to meet him in farewell outside the Guangyang city gate, with feasting, bestowals, music, grappling, and the hundred entertainments.

sentences.zh: 冬，閏十月，趙衝擊燒當羌於阿陽，破之。

translations.literal: In winter, the intercalary tenth month, Zhao Chong attacked the Shaohe Qiang at Ayang and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the intercalary tenth month, Zhao Chong attacked the Shaohe Qiang at Ayang and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十一月，使匈奴中郎將扶風馬寔遣人刺殺句龍吾斯。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the envoy of the Xiongnu Central Colonel Ma Shi of Fufeng sent men to assassinate Goulong Wusi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the envoy of the Xiongnu Central Colonel Ma Shi of Fufeng sent men to assassinate Goulong Wusi.

sentences.zh: 涼州自九月以來，地百八十震，山谷坼裂，壞敗城寺，民壓死者甚眾。

translations.literal: From the ninth month onward in Liang province the earth quaked one hundred eighty times; valleys split open; cities and temples were ruined; and among the people those crushed to death were very many.
translations.idiomatic: From the ninth month onward in Liang province the earth quaked one hundred eighty times. Valleys split open, cities and temples were ruined, and among the people those crushed to death were very many.

sentences.zh: 尚書令黃瓊以前左雄所上孝廉之選，專用儒學、文吏，於取士之義猶有所遺，乃奏增孝悌及能從政者為四科；

translations.literal: Director of the Secretariat Huang Qiong, because the selection of Filial and Incorrupt candidates that Zuo Xiong formerly submitted used only Confucian learning and clerical officials, still had something missing in the meaning of taking scholars, and so memorialized to add Filial Piety and Fraternal Duty and those able to take part in government as four categories;
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Secretariat Huang Qiong, because the selection of Filial and Incorrupt candidates that Zuo Xiong formerly submitted used only Confucian learning and clerical officials, still had something missing in the meaning of taking scholars, and so memorialized to add Filial Piety and Fraternal Duty and those able to take part in government as four categories;

sentences.zh: 帝從之。

translations.literal: the emperor followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed it.

sentences.zh: 春，護羌從事馬玄為諸羌所誘，將羌眾亡出塞，領護羌校尉衛琚追擊玄等，斬首八百餘級。

translations.literal: In spring, Protector of the Qiang Attendant Ma Xuan was enticed by the various Qiang, led the Qiang masses in flight beyond the passes, and Colonel Protector of the Qiang Wei Ju pursued and attacked Xuan and the others, taking more than eight hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, Protector of the Qiang Attendant Ma Xuan was enticed by the various Qiang, led the Qiang masses in flight beyond the passes, and Colonel Protector of the Qiang Wei Ju pursued and attacked Xuan and the others, taking more than eight hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 趙沖復追叛羌到建威鸇陰河；

translations.literal: Zhao Chong again pursued rebel Qiang to Jianwei at the Zhuanyin River;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Chong again pursued rebel Qiang to Jianwei at the Zhuanyin River;

sentences.zh: 軍度竟，所將降胡六百餘人叛走；

translations.literal: when the army had crossed to the end, more than six hundred surrendered Hu he led rebelled and fled;
translations.idiomatic: when the army had crossed to the end, more than six hundred surrendered Hu he led rebelled and fled;

sentences.zh: 衝將數百人追之，遇羌伏後，與戰而歿。

translations.literal: Chong led several hundred men in pursuit, met Qiang lying in ambush behind, fought, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Chong led several hundred men in pursuit, met Qiang lying in ambush behind, fought, and died.

sentences.zh: 沖雖死，而前後多所斬獲，羌由是衰耗。

translations.literal: Though Chong died, before and after there were many beheadings and captures, and the Qiang thereby declined and were exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Though Chong died, before and after there were many beheadings and captures, and the Qiang thereby declined and were exhausted.

sentences.zh: 詔封沖子為義陽亭侯。

translations.literal: An edict enfeoffed Chong's son as Marquis of Yiyang village.
translations.idiomatic: An edict enfeoffed Chong's son as Marquis of Yiyang village.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，使匈奴中郎將馬寔擊南匈奴左部，破之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, sent Xiongnu Central Colonel Ma Shi to attack the Southern Xiongnu Left Division and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fourth month, Xiongnu Central Colonel Ma Shi was sent to attack the Southern Xiongnu Left Division and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 於是胡、羌、烏桓悉詣寔降。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Hu, Qiang, and Wuhuan all came to Shi to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Hu, Qiang, and Wuhuan all came to Shi to surrender.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，立皇子炳為太子，改元，赦天下。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, established the imperial son Bing as heir apparent, changed the reign title, and amnestied the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, the imperial son Bing was established as heir apparent, the reign title was changed, and the realm was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 太子居承光宮，帝使侍御史種暠監其家。

translations.literal: The heir apparent dwelt in Chengguang Palace; the emperor sent Attending Clerk Zhong Hao to supervise his household.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent dwelt in Chengguang Palace. The emperor sent Attending Clerk Zhong Hao to supervise his household.

sentences.zh: 中常侍高梵從中單駕出迎太子，時太傅杜喬等疑不欲從而未決，暠乃手劍當車曰：「太子，國之儲副，人命所繫。

translations.literal: Regular Attendant Gao Fan came out from the inner palace with a single carriage to welcome the heir apparent. At the time Grand Tutor Du Qiao and others doubted and did not wish to follow yet had not decided. Hao then took sword in hand and blocked the carriage, saying: "The heir apparent is the state's reserve deputy; human lives depend on him.
translations.idiomatic: Regular Attendant Gao Fan came out from the inner palace with a single carriage to welcome the heir apparent. At the time Grand Tutor Du Qiao and others doubted and did not wish to follow yet had not decided. Hao then took sword in hand and blocked the carriage, saying, "The heir apparent is the state's reserve deputy. Human lives depend on him.

sentences.zh: 今常侍來，無詔信，何以知非奸邪？

translations.literal: " Now a regular attendant comes without edict or credential—how does one know he is not treacherous and wicked?
translations.idiomatic: " Now a regular attendant comes without edict or credential—how does one know he is not treacherous and wicked?

sentences.zh: 今日有死而已！

translations.literal: " Today there is only death!
translations.idiomatic: " Today there is only death!

sentences.zh: 」梵辭屈，不敢對，馳還奏之。

translations.literal: " Fan was defeated in words, dared not reply, and galloped back to report.
translations.idiomatic: " Fan was defeated in words, dared not reply, and galloped back to report.

sentences.zh: 詔報，太子乃得去。

translations.literal: An edict replied, and the heir apparent then was able to go.
translations.idiomatic: An edict replied, and the heir apparent then was able to go.

sentences.zh: 喬退而歎息，愧暠臨事不惑；

translations.literal: Qiao withdrew and sighed, ashamed that Hao in the affair was not confused;
translations.idiomatic: Qiao withdrew and sighed, ashamed that Hao in the affair was not confused;

sentences.zh: 帝亦嘉其持重，稱善者良久。

translations.literal: the emperor also praised his steadiness and spoke approval for a long while.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor also praised his steadiness and spoke approval for a long while.

sentences.zh: 揚、徐盜賊群起，盤互連歲。

translations.literal: In Yang and Xu bandits rose in groups, entwined year after year.
translations.idiomatic: In Yang and Xu bandits rose in groups, entwined year after year.

sentences.zh: 秋，八月，九江范容、周生等寇掠城邑，屯據歷陽，為江、淮巨患；

translations.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, Fan Rong of Jiujiang, Zhou Sheng, and others raided and plundered cities and towns, encamped and held Liyang, and were a great calamity of the Jiang and Huai;
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, in the eighth month, Fan Rong of Jiujiang, Zhou Sheng, and others raided and plundered cities and towns, encamped and held Liyang, and were a great calamity of the Jiang and Huai;

sentences.zh: 遣御史中丞馮緄督州兵討之。

translations.literal: sent Imperial Secretary Feng Gun to supervise commandery troops in punishing them.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Secretary Feng Gun was sent to supervise commandery troops in punishing them.

sentences.zh: 庚午，帝崩於玉堂前殿。

translations.literal: On gengwu day the emperor died in the Jade Hall front palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the emperor died in the Jade Hall front palace.

sentences.zh: 太子即皇帝位，年二歲。

translations.literal: The heir apparent ascended the imperial throne; he was two years old.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent ascended the imperial throne. He was two years old.

sentences.zh: 尊皇后曰皇太后。

translations.literal: The empress was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: The empress was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 太后臨朝。

translations.literal: The empress dowager held court.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager held court.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以太尉趙峻為太傅，大司農李固為太尉，參錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, made Grand Commandant Zhao Jun Grand Tutor and Grand Minister of Agriculture Li Gu Grand Commandant, with participation in recording Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Grand Commandant Zhao Jun was made Grand Tutor and Grand Minister of Agriculture Li Gu was made Grand Commandant, with participation in recording Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月，丙午，葬孝順皇帝於憲陵，廟曰敬宗。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingwu day, buried Filial and Obedient Emperor at Xianling; his temple title is Jingzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingwu day, Filial and Obedient Emperor was buried at Xianling. His temple title is Jingzong.

sentences.zh: 是日，京師及太原、雁門地震。

translations.literal: That day the capital together with Taiyuan and Yanmen had earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: That day the capital, together with Taiyuan and Yanmen, had earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔舉賢良方正之士，策問之。

translations.literal: On gengxu day an edict ordered the recommendation of worthy and upright gentlemen for policy questioning.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict ordered the recommendation of worthy and upright gentlemen for policy questioning.

sentences.zh: 皇甫規對曰：「伏惟孝順皇帝初勤王政，紀綱四方，幾以獲安；

translations.literal: Huangfu Gui replied, saying: "Your servant considers that Emperor Shun at first diligently governed royal affairs and ordered the four quarters, and almost attained peace;"
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Gui replied, saying, "Your servant considers that Emperor Shun at first diligently governed royal affairs and ordered the four quarters, and almost attained peace;"

sentences.zh: 後遭奸偽，威分近習，受賂賣爵，賓客交錯，天下擾擾，從亂如歸，官民並竭，上下窮虛。

translations.literal: "afterward he met treacherous falsity, authority was divided among close attendants, bribes were taken and ranks sold, guests and clients crisscrossed, all under heaven was in turmoil, joining disorder as if returning home, officials and people were both exhausted, above and below were destitute and empty."
translations.idiomatic: "afterward he met treacherous falsity. Authority was divided among close attendants, bribes were taken and ranks sold, guests and clients crisscrossed, all under heaven was in turmoil, and people joined disorder as if returning home. Officials and people were both exhausted, and above and below were destitute and empty."

sentences.zh: 陛下體兼乾坤，聰哲純茂，攝政之初，拔用忠貞，其餘維綱，多所改正，遠近翕然望見太平，而災異不息，寇賊縱橫，殆以奸臣權重之所致也。

translations.literal: "Your Majesty's person embraces heaven and earth, pure in wisdom and virtue; at the start of regency you raised the loyal and straight, and of the rest of the sustaining cords many were corrected. Near and far alike looked to see great peace—yet prodigies do not cease and bandits roam at will, probably because treacherous ministers' power is heavy."
translations.idiomatic: "Your Majesty's person embraces heaven and earth and is pure in wisdom and virtue. At the start of regency you raised the loyal and straight, and of the rest of the sustaining cords many were corrected. Near and far alike looked to see great peace—yet prodigies do not cease and bandits roam at will, probably because treacherous ministers' power is too heavy."

sentences.zh: 其常侍尤無狀者，宜亟黜遣，披掃凶黨，收入財賄，以塞痛怨，以答天誡。

translations.literal: "Among the Regular Attendants those most lawless should be swiftly dismissed and expelled, the vicious faction swept away, their bribes and goods seized, to block bitter resentment and answer Heaven's warning."
translations.idiomatic: "Among the Regular Attendants those most lawless should be swiftly dismissed and expelled, the vicious faction swept away, and their bribes and goods seized, to block bitter resentment and answer Heaven's warning."

sentences.zh: 大將軍冀、河南尹不疑，亦宜增修謙節，輔以儒術，省去游娛不急之務，割減廬第無益之飾。

translations.literal: "Grand General Ji and Henan Intendant Bu Yi should also further cultivate modest conduct, be aided by Confucian learning, cut away idle amusements and unurgent affairs, and reduce useless ornament in their lodges and mansions."
translations.idiomatic: "Grand General Ji and Henan Intendant Bu Yi should also further cultivate modest conduct, be aided by Confucian learning, cut away idle amusements and unurgent affairs, and reduce useless ornament in their lodges and mansions."

sentences.zh: 夫君者，舟也；

translations.literal: "The ruler is a boat;"
translations.idiomatic: "The ruler is a boat;"

sentences.zh: 民者，水也；

translations.literal: "the people are water;"
translations.idiomatic: "the people are water;"

sentences.zh: 群臣，乘舟者也；

translations.literal: "ministers are those who ride the boat;"
translations.idiomatic: "ministers are those who ride the boat;"

sentences.zh: 將軍兄弟，操楫者也。

translations.literal: "the general's brothers hold the oars."
translations.idiomatic: "the general's brothers hold the oars."

sentences.zh: 若能平志畢力，以度元元，所謂福也。

translations.literal: "If they can level their wills and exhaust their strength to measure out the common folk, that is what is called blessing."
translations.idiomatic: "If they can level their wills and exhaust their strength to measure out the common folk, that is what is called blessing."

sentences.zh: 如其怠弛，將淪波濤，可不慎乎！

translations.literal: "If they are slack and lax, they will sink in the waves—can one not be cautious!"
translations.idiomatic: "If they are slack and lax, they will sink in the waves—can one not be cautious!"

sentences.zh: 夫德不稱祿，猶鑿墉之趾以益其高，豈量力審功，安固之道哉！

translations.literal: "When virtue does not match salary, it is like chiseling a wall's foot to raise its height—how is that measuring strength and examining achievement, the way to secure stability!"
translations.idiomatic: "When virtue does not match salary, it is like chiseling a wall's foot to raise its height—how is that measuring strength and examining achievement, the way to secure stability!"

sentences.zh: 凡諸宿猾、酒徒、戲客，皆宜貶斥，以懲不軌。

translations.literal: "All old rogues, wine companions, and play guests should be demoted and expelled to punish irregular conduct."
translations.idiomatic: "All old rogues, wine companions, and play guests should be demoted and expelled to punish irregular conduct."

sentences.zh: 令冀等深思得賢之福，失人之累。

translations.literal: "Let Ji and the others deeply think on the blessing of obtaining the worthy and the burden of losing men."
translations.idiomatic: "Let Ji and the others deeply think on the blessing of obtaining the worthy and the burden of losing men."

sentences.zh: 」梁冀忿之，以規為下第，拜郎中；

translations.literal: " Liang Ji was angry at this, ranked Gui in the lowest grade, and appointed him Palace Gentleman;
translations.idiomatic: " Liang Ji was angry at this, ranked Gui in the lowest grade, and appointed him Palace Gentleman;

sentences.zh: 托疾，免歸，州郡承冀旨，幾陷死者再三，遂沉廢於家，積十餘年。

translations.literal: he pleaded illness and was dismissed to return home; commanderies and districts followed Ji's intent, and several times he nearly died in traps, until he sank into disuse at home for more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: he pleaded illness and was dismissed to return home. Commanderies and districts followed Ji's intent, and several times he nearly died in traps, until he sank into disuse at home for more than ten years.

sentences.zh: 揚州刺史尹耀、九江太守鄧顯討范容等於歷陽，敗歿。

translations.literal: Inspector of Yangzhou Yin Yao and Administrator of Jiujiang Deng Xian attacked Fan Rong and others at Liyang and were defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Yangzhou Yin Yao and Administrator of Jiujiang Deng Xian attacked Fan Rong and others at Liyang and were defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，日南蠻夷復反，攻燒縣邑。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, the Man and Yi of Rinan again rebelled, attacking and burning counties and towns.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, in the tenth month, the Man and Yi of Rinan again rebelled, attacking and burning counties and towns.

sentences.zh: 交趾刺史九江夏方招誘降之。

translations.literal: Inspector of Jiaozhi Xia Fang of Jiujiang induced and accepted their surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Jiaozhi Xia Fang of Jiujiang induced and accepted their surrender.

sentences.zh: 十一月，九江盜賊徐鳳、馬勉等攻燒城邑；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, bandits of Jiujiang Xu Feng, Ma Mian, and others attacked and burned cities and towns;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, bandits of Jiujiang Xu Feng, Ma Mian, and others attacked and burned cities and towns;

sentences.zh: 鳳稱無上將軍，勉稱皇帝，築營於當塗山中，建年號，置百官。

translations.literal: Feng styled himself Supreme General, Mian styled himself Emperor, built camps in Dangtu mountain, established an era name, and installed the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: Feng styled himself Supreme General, Mian styled himself Emperor, built camps in Dangtu mountain, established an era name, and installed the hundred offices.

sentences.zh: 十二月，九江賊黃虎等攻合肥。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Jiujiang bandit Huang Hu and others attacked Hefei.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Jiujiang bandit Huang Hu and others attacked Hefei.

sentences.zh: 是歲，群盜發憲陵。

translations.literal: That year a host of bandits broke into Xian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: That year a host of bandits broke into Xian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 漢孝皇帝

translations.literal: Han Filial Emperor
translations.idiomatic: Han Filial Emperor

sentences.zh: 春，正月，戊戌，帝崩於玉堂前殿。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on wuxu day, the Emperor died in the front hall of the Jade Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, in the first month, on wuxu day, the Emperor died in the front hall of the Jade Hall.

sentences.zh: 梁太后以揚、徐盜賊方盛，欲須所征諸王侯到乃發喪。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Liang, because bandits in Yang and Xu were still strong, wished to wait until the summoned kings and marquises arrived before announcing the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Liang, because bandits in Yang and Xu were still strong, wished to wait until the summoned kings and marquises arrived before announcing the mourning.

sentences.zh: 太尉李固曰：「帝雖幼少，猶天下之父。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Li Gu said: "Though the Emperor was young, he was still father to all under heaven."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Li Gu said, "Though the Emperor was young, he was still father to all under heaven."

sentences.zh: 今日崩亡，人神感動，豈有人子反共掩匿乎！

translations.literal: "Today he has died and collapsed—men and spirits are moved; how could any human child in turn together conceal it!"
translations.idiomatic: "Today he has died—men and spirits are moved. How could any human child in turn together conceal it!"

sentences.zh: 昔秦皇沙丘之謀及近日北鄉之事，皆秘不發喪，此天下大忌，不可之甚者也！

translations.literal: "Formerly the First Emperor of Qin's plot at Shaji and recently the affair at Beixiang—all kept the mourning secret and did not announce it. These are great taboos under heaven and must not be carried to extremes!"
translations.idiomatic: "Formerly the First Emperor of Qin's plot at Shaji and recently the affair at Beixiang—all kept the mourning secret and did not announce it. These are great taboos under heaven and must not be carried to extremes!"

sentences.zh: 」太后從之，即暮發喪。

translations.literal: " The Dowager followed this and that very evening announced the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: " The Dowager followed this and that very evening announced the mourning.

sentences.zh: 征清河王蒜及渤海孝王鴻之子纘皆至京師。

translations.literal: The summoned Prince Su of Qinghe and Zuan, son of Filial King Hong of Bohai, both reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The summoned Prince Su of Qinghe and Zuan, son of Filial King Hong of Bohai, both reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 蒜父曰清河恭王延平；

translations.literal: Su's father was Respectful King Yanping of Qinghe;
translations.idiomatic: Su's father was Respectful King Yanping of Qinghe;

sentences.zh: 延平及鴻皆樂安夷王寵之子，千乘貞王伉之孫也。

translations.literal: Yanping and Hong were both sons of King Chong of Le'an, grandsons of Upright King Kang of Qiancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yanping and Hong were both sons of King Chong of Le'an, grandsons of Upright King Kang of Qiancheng.

sentences.zh: 清河王為人嚴重，動止有法度，公卿皆歸心焉。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qinghe was grave in person; his movements and stops had law and measure, and dukes and ministers all turned their hearts to him.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qinghe was grave in person. His movements and stops had law and measure, and dukes and ministers all turned their hearts to him.

sentences.zh: 李固謂大將軍冀曰：「今當立帝，宜擇長年，高明有德，任親政事者，願將軍審詳大計，察周、霍之立文、宣，戒鄧、閻之利幼弱！

translations.literal: Li Gu said to Grand General Ji: "Now in establishing an emperor one should choose one mature in years, lofty and bright in virtue, able to handle close affairs of government. Your servant wishes the general to examine the great plan carefully, observe how Zhou and Huo established Wen and Xuan, and take warning from how Deng and Yan profited from installing the young and weak!"
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu said to Grand General Ji, "Now in establishing an emperor one should choose one mature in years, lofty and bright in virtue, and able to handle close affairs of government. Your servant wishes the general to examine the great plan carefully, observe how Zhou and Huo established Wen and Xuan, and take warning from how Deng and Yan profited from installing the young and weak!"

sentences.zh: 」冀不從，與太后定策禁中。

translations.literal: " Ji did not follow this but with the Dowager fixed the plan within the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: " Ji did not follow this but with the Dowager fixed the plan within the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，冀持節以王青蓋車迎纘入南宮。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Ji, bearing the staff of authority, welcomed Zuan into the Southern Palace in the king's green-canopied carriage.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Ji, bearing the staff of authority, welcomed Zuan into the Southern Palace in the king's green-canopied carriage.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，封為建平侯。

translations.literal: On dingsi day he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jianping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jianping.

sentences.zh: 其日，即皇帝位，年八歲。

translations.literal: That same day he took the imperial throne; he was eight years old.
translations.idiomatic: That same day he took the imperial throne. He was eight years old.

sentences.zh: 蒜罷歸國。

translations.literal: Su was dismissed and returned to his state.
translations.idiomatic: Su was dismissed and returned to his state.

sentences.zh: 將卜山陵，李固曰：「今處處寇賊，軍興費廣，新創憲陵，賦發非一。

translations.literal: When they were about to divine the mountain tomb, Li Gu said: "Now bandits are everywhere, military costs are vast, Xian Mausoleum was newly built, and levies are many."
translations.idiomatic: When they were about to divine the mountain tomb, Li Gu said, "Now bandits are everywhere, military costs are vast, Xian Mausoleum was newly built, and levies are many."

sentences.zh: 帝尚幼小，可起陵於憲陵塋內，依康陵制度。

translations.literal: "The Emperor is still young; his tomb may be raised within the precinct of Xian Mausoleum, following the institution of Kang Mausoleum."
translations.idiomatic: "The Emperor is still young. His tomb may be raised within the precinct of Xian Mausoleum, following the institution of Kang Mausoleum."

sentences.zh: 」太后從之。

translations.literal: " The Dowager followed this.
translations.idiomatic: " The Dowager followed this.

sentences.zh: 己未，葬孝沖皇帝於懷陵。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Filial Emperor Chong was buried at Huai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Filial Emperor Chong was buried at Huai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 太后委政宰輔，李固所言，太后多從之，黃門宦官為惡者一皆斥遣，天下鹹望治平。

translations.literal: The Dowager entrusted government to the chief ministers; what Li Gu said the Dowager mostly followed, and wicked eunuchs of the Yellow Gates were all expelled. All under heaven looked to good order and peace.
translations.idiomatic: The Dowager entrusted government to the chief ministers. What Li Gu said the Dowager mostly followed, and wicked eunuchs of the Yellow Gates were all expelled. All under heaven looked to good order and peace.

sentences.zh: 而梁冀深忌疾之。

translations.literal: Yet Liang Ji deeply hated and resented him.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Liang Ji deeply hated and resented him.

sentences.zh: 初，順帝時所除官多不以次；

translations.literal: Initially, offices appointed in Emperor Shun's time were often not in proper order;
translations.idiomatic: Initially, offices appointed in Emperor Shun's time were often not in proper order;

sentences.zh: 及固在事，奏免百餘人。

translations.literal: when Gu was in office he memorialized to dismiss more than a hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: when Gu was in office he memorialized to dismiss more than a hundred men.

sentences.zh: 此等既怨，又希望冀旨，遂共作飛章誣奏固曰：「太尉李固，因公假私，依正行邪，離間近戚，自隆支黨。

translations.literal: These men were already resentful and also hoped for Ji's intent; thereupon they jointly made a flying memorial falsely accusing Gu, saying: "Grand Commandant Li Gu uses public office for private ends, relies on the upright to act crookedly, estranges close kin, and exalts his own faction."
translations.idiomatic: These men were already resentful and also hoped for Ji's intent. Thereupon they jointly made a flying memorial falsely accusing Gu, saying, "Grand Commandant Li Gu uses public office for private ends, relies on the upright to act crookedly, estranges close kin, and exalts his own faction."

sentences.zh: 大行在殯，路人掩涕，固獨胡粉飾貌，搔頭弄姿，槃旋偃仰，從容治步，曾無慘怛傷悴之心。

translations.literal: "The late sovereign lies in the coffin and travelers on the road cover their faces in tears, yet Gu alone powders his face and ornaments his looks, scratches his head and plays with his bearing, turns round reclining and rising, walks with easy composure—never a heart of grief and sorrow."
translations.idiomatic: "The late sovereign lies in the coffin and travelers on the road cover their faces in tears, yet Gu alone powders his face and ornaments his looks, scratches his head and plays with his bearing, turns round reclining and rising, and walks with easy composure—never a heart of grief and sorrow."

sentences.zh: 山陵未成，違矯舊政，善則稱己，過則歸君；

translations.literal: "The mountain tomb is not yet complete, yet he violates and bends old government—what is good he claims for himself, what is faulty he assigns to the ruler;"
translations.idiomatic: "The mountain tomb is not yet complete, yet he violates and bends old government—what is good he claims for himself, and what is faulty he assigns to the ruler;"

sentences.zh: 斥逐近臣，不得侍送。

translations.literal: "he expels and drives away close attendants so they cannot serve and escort."
translations.idiomatic: "he expels and drives away close attendants so they cannot serve and escort."

sentences.zh: 作威作福，莫固之甚矣！

translations.literal: "Making might and making blessing—none exceeds Gu in this!"
translations.idiomatic: "Making might and making blessing—none exceeds Gu in this!"

sentences.zh: 夫子罪莫大於累父，臣惡莫深於毀君，固之過釁，事合誅辟。

translations.literal: "The Master's saying: no crime is greater than bringing down one's father; no wickedness of a minister is deeper than destroying his ruler. Gu's excess fault and offense fit execution by law."
translations.idiomatic: "The Master's saying: no crime is greater than bringing down one's father; no wickedness of a minister is deeper than destroying his ruler. Gu's excess fault and offense fit execution by law."

sentences.zh: 」書奏，冀以白太后，使下其書；

translations.literal: " The memorial was submitted; Ji reported it to the Dowager and had the document sent down;
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was submitted. Ji reported it to the Dowager and had the document sent down;

sentences.zh: 太后不聽。

translations.literal: the Dowager would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: the Dowager would not listen.

sentences.zh: 廣陵賊張嬰復聚眾數千人反，據廣陵。

translations.literal: The Guangling bandit Zhang Ying again gathered several thousand men in rebellion and held Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangling bandit Zhang Ying again gathered several thousand men in rebellion and held Guangling.

sentences.zh: 二月，乙酉，赦天下。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yiyou day, amnesty was declared for all under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiyou day, amnesty was declared for all under heaven.

sentences.zh: 西羌叛亂積年，費用八十餘億。

translations.literal: The Western Qiang rebellion had piled up for years; expenses exceeded eight billion.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Qiang rebellion had piled up for years. Expenses exceeded eight billion.

sentences.zh: 諸將多斷盜牢稟，私自潤入，皆以珍寶貨賂左右。

translations.literal: The generals mostly intercepted and stole the garrison grain, privately enriching themselves, and all used gems and treasures to bribe those around the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The generals mostly intercepted and stole the garrison grain and privately enriched themselves, and all used gems and treasures to bribe those around the throne.

sentences.zh: 上下放縱，不恤軍事，士卒不得其死者，白骨相望於野。

translations.literal: Above and below were lax and indulgent, uncaring of military affairs; soldiers did not obtain death in due course, and white bones looked at one another across the fields.
translations.idiomatic: Above and below were lax and indulgent and uncaring of military affairs. Soldiers did not obtain death in due course, and white bones looked at one another across the fields.

sentences.zh: 左馮翊梁並以恩信招誘叛羌；

translations.literal: Liang Bing, Intendant of the Left of Fengyi, with grace and trust induced the rebellious Qiang;
translations.idiomatic: Liang Bing, Intendant of the Left of Fengyi, with grace and trust induced the rebellious Qiang;

sentences.zh: 離湳、狐奴等五萬餘戶皆詣並降，隴右復平。

translations.literal: more than fifty thousand households of Liqian, Hunu, and others all came to Bing and surrendered, and Longyou was again pacified.
translations.idiomatic: more than fifty thousand households of Liqian, Hunu, and others all came to Bing and surrendered, and Longyou was again pacified.

sentences.zh: 太后以徐、揚盜賊益熾，博求將帥。

translations.literal: The Dowager, because bandits in Xu and Yang grew ever fiercer, broadly sought generals.
translations.idiomatic: The Dowager, because bandits in Xu and Yang grew ever fiercer, broadly sought generals.

sentences.zh: 三公舉涿令北海滕撫有文武才；

translations.literal: The Three Excellencies recommended Magistrate of Zhuo Teng Fu of Beihai as having civil and military talent;
translations.idiomatic: The Three Excellencies recommended Magistrate of Zhuo Teng Fu of Beihai as having civil and military talent;

sentences.zh: 詔拜撫九江都尉，與中郎將趙序助馮緄，合州郡兵數萬人共討之。

translations.literal: an edict appointed Fu Colonel of Jiujiang, to assist Feng Gun together with Colonel of the Gentlemen Zhao Xu, combining commandery and district troops numbering tens of thousands to attack them jointly.
translations.idiomatic: an edict appointed Fu Colonel of Jiujiang to assist Feng Gun together with Colonel of the Gentlemen Zhao Xu, combining commandery and district troops numbering tens of thousands to attack them jointly.

sentences.zh: 又廣開賞募，錢、邑各有差。

translations.literal: Rewards and bounties were also broadly opened, with money and fiefs each graded.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards and bounties were also broadly opened, with money and fiefs each graded.

sentences.zh: 又議遣太尉李固，未及行。

translations.literal: They also deliberated sending Grand Commandant Li Gu, but before he could go.
translations.idiomatic: They also deliberated sending Grand Commandant Li Gu, but he had not yet departed.

sentences.zh: 三月，撫等進擊眾賊，大破之，斬馬勉、范容、周生等千五百級。

translations.literal: In the third month, Fu and others advanced to attack the mass of bandits and routed them greatly, beheading Ma Mian, Fan Rong, Zhou Sheng, and others to the number of fifteen hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Fu and others advanced to attack the mass of bandits and routed them greatly, beheading Ma Mian, Fan Rong, Zhou Sheng, and others to the number of fifteen hundred.

sentences.zh: 徐鳳以餘眾燒東城縣。

translations.literal: Xu Feng with the remnant host burned Dongcheng county.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Feng with the remnant host burned Dongcheng county.

sentences.zh: 夏，五月，下邳人謝安應募，率其宗親設伏擊鳳，斬之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, Xie An of Xiapi answered the bounty, led his clan and kin to set an ambush and strike Feng, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, in the fifth month, Xie An of Xiapi answered the bounty, led his clan and kin to set an ambush and strike Feng, and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 封安為平鄉侯。

translations.literal: An was enfeoffed as Marquis of Pingxiang.
translations.idiomatic: An was enfeoffed as Marquis of Pingxiang.

sentences.zh: 拜滕撫中郎將，督揚、徐二州事。

translations.literal: Teng Fu was appointed Colonel of the Gentlemen and supervised the affairs of the two provinces Yang and Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Teng Fu was appointed Colonel of the Gentlemen and supervised the affairs of the two provinces Yang and Xu.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔曰：「孝殤皇帝即位逾年，君臣禮成。

translations.literal: On bingchen day an edict said: "Filial Emperor Shang had been on the throne more than a year; ruler and ministers' ritual was complete."
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict said, "Filial Emperor Shang had been on the throne more than a year; ruler and ministers' ritual was complete."

sentences.zh: 孝安皇帝承襲統業，而前世遂令恭陵在康陵之上，先後相逾，失其次序。
