translations.literal: "Filial Emperor An inherited the unified enterprise, yet the previous age had placed Gong Mausoleum above Kang Mausoleum—the former and latter overstepped one another and lost proper order."
translations.idiomatic: "Filial Emperor An inherited the unified enterprise, yet the previous age had placed Gong Mausoleum above Kang Mausoleum—the former and latter overstepped one another and lost proper order."

sentences.zh: 今其正之！

translations.literal: "Now rectify this!"
translations.idiomatic: "Now rectify this!"

sentences.zh: 六月，鮮卑寇代郡。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Xianbei raided Dai commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Xianbei raided Dai commandery.

sentences.zh: 秋，廬江盜賊攻尋陽，又攻盱台。

translations.literal: In autumn, bandits of Lujiang attacked Xunyang and also attacked Yutai.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, bandits of Lujiang attacked Xunyang and also attacked Yutai.

sentences.zh: 滕撫遣司馬王章擊破之。

translations.literal: Teng Fu sent Major Wang Zhang to attack and defeat them.
translations.idiomatic: Teng Fu sent Major Wang Zhang to attack and defeat them.

sentences.zh: 九月，庚戌，太傅趙峻薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengxu day, Grand Tutor Zhao Jun died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengxu day, Grand Tutor Zhao Jun died.

sentences.zh: 滕撫進擊張嬰；

translations.literal: Teng Fu advanced to attack Zhang Ying;
translations.idiomatic: Teng Fu advanced to attack Zhang Ying;

sentences.zh: 冬，十一月，丙午，破嬰，斬獲千餘人。

translations.literal: in winter, the eleventh month, on bingwu day, he defeated Ying and beheaded and captured more than a thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: in winter, in the eleventh month, on bingwu day, he defeated Ying and beheaded and captured more than a thousand men.

sentences.zh: 丁未，中郎將趙序坐畏懦、詐增首級，棄市。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Colonel of the Gentlemen Zhao Xu, charged with cowardice and falsely inflating heads taken, was exposed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Colonel of the Gentlemen Zhao Xu, charged with cowardice and falsely inflating heads taken, was exposed in the market.

sentences.zh: 歷陽賊華孟自稱黑帝，攻殺九江太守楊岑。

translations.literal: The Liyang bandit Hua Meng styled himself Black Emperor and attacked and killed Administrator of Jiujiang Yang Cen.
translations.idiomatic: The Liyang bandit Hua Meng styled himself Black Emperor and attacked and killed Administrator of Jiujiang Yang Cen.

sentences.zh: 滕撫進擊，破之，斬孟等三千八百級，虜獲七百餘人。

translations.literal: Teng Fu advanced to attack, defeated them, and beheaded Meng and others to the number of thirty-eight hundred, capturing more than seven hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Teng Fu advanced to attack and defeated them, beheading Meng and others to the number of thirty-eight hundred and capturing more than seven hundred.

sentences.zh: 於是東南悉平，振旅而還。

translations.literal: Thereupon the southeast was entirely pacified; he shook out the troops and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the southeast was entirely pacified. He shook out the troops and returned.

sentences.zh: 以撫為左馮翊。

translations.literal: Fu was made Intendant of the Left of Fengyi.
translations.idiomatic: Fu was made Intendant of the Left of Fengyi.

sentences.zh: 永昌太守劉君世，鑄黃金為文蛇，以獻大將軍冀；

translations.literal: Administrator of Yongchang Liu Junshi cast gold into an inscribed serpent and presented it to Grand General Ji;
translations.idiomatic: Administrator of Yongchang Liu Junshi cast gold into an inscribed serpent and presented it to Grand General Ji;

sentences.zh: 益州刺史種暠糾發逮捕，馳傳上言。

translations.literal: Inspector of Yizhou Zhong Hao investigated, exposed, and arrested him, and by rapid post memorialized above.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Yizhou Zhong Hao investigated, exposed, and arrested him, and by rapid post memorialized above.

sentences.zh: 冀由是恨暠。

translations.literal: Ji thereby hated Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Ji thereby hated Hao.

sentences.zh: 會巴郡人服直聚黨數百人，自稱天王，暠與太守應承討捕，不克，吏民多被傷害；

translations.literal: It happened that Fu Zhi of Ba commandery gathered a party of several hundred men and styled himself Heavenly King. Hao together with the Administrator Ying Cheng pursued and captured them but did not overcome them; officials and people suffered many injuries;
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Fu Zhi of Ba commandery gathered a party of several hundred men and styled himself Heavenly King. Hao together with the Administrator Ying Cheng pursued and captured them but did not overcome them, and officials and people suffered many injuries;

sentences.zh: 冀因此陷之，傳逮暠、承。

translations.literal: Ji used this to trap them and by post summoned Hao and Cheng for arrest.
translations.idiomatic: Ji used this to trap them and by post summoned Hao and Cheng for arrest.

sentences.zh: 李固上疏曰：「臣伏聞討捕所傷，本非暠、承之意，實由縣吏懼法畏罪，迫逐深苦，致此不詳。

translations.literal: Li Gu submitted a memorial, saying: "Your servant has heard that the injuries in the pursuit and capture were not originally Hao's and Cheng's intent; truly it was because district clerks feared the law and dreaded punishment, pressing the pursuit with deep harshness and bringing this misfortune."
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu submitted a memorial, saying, "Your servant has heard that the injuries in the pursuit and capture were not originally Hao's and Cheng's intent. Truly it was because district clerks feared the law and dreaded punishment, pressed the pursuit with deep harshness, and brought this misfortune."

sentences.zh: 比盜賊群起，處處未絕。

translations.literal: "Just now bandits rise in masses and are not yet ended anywhere."
translations.idiomatic: "Just now bandits rise in masses and are not yet ended anywhere."

sentences.zh: 暠、承以首舉大奸而相隨受罪，臣恐沮傷州縣糾發之意，更共飾匿，莫復盡心！

translations.literal: "Hao and Cheng, for having been first to expose a great villain, follow into punishment—your servant fears this will discourage the intent of provinces and districts to investigate and expose, and they will again together cover and conceal, no longer doing their utmost!"
translations.idiomatic: "Hao and Cheng, for having been first to expose a great villain, follow into punishment—your servant fears this will discourage the intent of provinces and districts to investigate and expose, and they will again together cover and conceal, no longer doing their utmost!"

sentences.zh: 」太后省奏，乃赦暠、承罪，免官而已。

translations.literal: " The Dowager examined the memorial and thereupon pardoned Hao's and Cheng's crimes, dismissing them from office only.
translations.idiomatic: " The Dowager examined the memorial and thereupon pardoned Hao's and Cheng's crimes, dismissing them from office only.

sentences.zh: 金蛇輸司農，冀從大司農杜喬借觀之，喬不肯與；

translations.literal: The golden serpent was delivered to the Minister of Agriculture; Ji asked to borrow it for viewing from Grand Minister of Agriculture Du Qiao, and Qiao would not give it;
translations.idiomatic: The golden serpent was delivered to the Minister of Agriculture. Ji asked to borrow it for viewing from Grand Minister of Agriculture Du Qiao, and Qiao would not give it;

sentences.zh: 冀小女死，令公卿會喪，喬獨不往，冀由是銜之。

translations.literal: Ji's young daughter died; he ordered the dukes and ministers to attend the mourning, but Qiao alone did not go—Ji thereby harbored resentment against him.
translations.idiomatic: Ji's young daughter died. He ordered the dukes and ministers to attend the mourning, but Qiao alone did not go. Ji thereby harbored resentment against him.

sentences.zh: category:資治通鑑
